results.q: Hey what happened at the Rayban event?
results.trace: Incidents · Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 Launc… (3) Show overview · Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 Launch INC-2026-0612 INC-2026-0613 INC-2026-0625 12.3 s · 3 steps
results.answer:
Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 Launch — Harbor Reveal at Pier 26, June 29th — had a rough 4 minutes on air, plus one catch in test the day before.

Show went live at 9:00 AM ET. All 14 departments were approved, show is now Complete.

Here's the post-mortem, most severe first:

1. SEV-2 — Primary SRT contribution lost, 38s of rebuffering — INC-2026-0612

What / when: At 9:14 AM, 14 minutes into the show, primary SRT from Pier 26 went from 0% to 18% loss in 6 seconds. MediaLive didn't fail over to the LiveU bonded backup for 29 seconds.
Viewer impact: Every destination — Facebook, Instagram, meta.com — froze. ~297k viewers affected, rebuffering spiked to 7.8% vs 0.4% baseline, for about 38 seconds. Total event 3m 41s on backup. Broke the 99.9% availability target for the event — hit 99.55%.
Root cause: A failing SFP on the venue access switch in the Pier 26 hut flapped the single 1GbE municipal fiber. SRT latency was 1,200ms — too short for an open-water site — and the MediaLive auto-failover threshold had been raised from 2s to 10s after a false failover in rehearsal.
Fix: Auto-failover to LiveU input 2, ran clean for 3 min, then TOC switched back to primary manually during a planned VT once SRT held at 0% for 2 min. SFP replaced post-show.

2. SEV-3 — Captions missing on Facebook for 6 minutes — INC-2026-0613

What / when: Right after that failover at 9:15 AM, CEA-608 captions stopped on Facebook Live until 9:21 AM.
Viewer impact: ~180k viewers, 6m 02s with no captions on Facebook. WebVTT on meta.com was fine.
Root cause: The EEG Falcon was inserting 608 only on the primary SDI path — the LiveU backup carried no caption data.
Fix: Captions returned when we switched back to primary. Facebook took ~3 min to resume rendering.

3. SEV-4 — LiveU modem on stale firmware in test — INC-2026-0625

What / when: June 28th, day-before signal-path test. Bonded throughput 14 Mbps vs 20 Mbps target because one 5G modem was on old firmware and only negotiated LTE.
Viewer impact: None — caught in test. Updated on site, retest held 24 Mbps.

Still open:

INC-2026-0612: Add venue switch SNMP/syslog for CRC / link flaps to the TOC wall — Network Eng D. Okafor — was due Aug 1, still Open
INC-2026-0613: Add caption-presence probe per destination to the monitoring wall — Streaming Eng K. Rhodes — was due Aug 1, still Open

Everything else from those reports — 2s failover standard, 2,000ms SRT for open-water, diverse-path requirement, captions upstream of the split — is marked Done.

Want me to pull up the full timeline or the streaming telemetry from that morning?
